items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: Buddy Wade was the drummer. He had brought his car up there, and he went on ahead of me. ... we was playing at the country club.

ctx.x: Did you ever have to go through the back door at a white club? Do you remember having?

Oh, yeah. Yeah. Let me tell you what. This is not a back door incident, but I'm going to tell you about an incident. I was in, I was in Shreveport, Louisiana, and we was playing at the country club. We was playing at, and it wasn't cross-play, because I played all the country clubs in Shreveport. But anyway, Buddy Wade was the drummer. He had brought his car up there, and he went on ahead of me. And when he got to the club, it was about 13 steps up front, up the, you know, to go in the front door. And now they…
So he construed that that was the back door.
